public_docs.notes: No public documentation, help center, or developer-portal link appears in the navigation or footer. Targeted searches did not locate public documentation.

raised_18mo.notes: The $30 million seed financing was announced within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026. The investor's description placing the raise eight months before August 2026 also falls within the window.

founded_year.notes: Both funding databases report 2025; LinkedIn instead reports 2026, so public sources conflict.

last_funding.notes: Announced August 3, 2026, led by CRV. An investor account says the seed financing was raised eight months before the announcement; the date here is the publicly announced round date, not a verified closing date.

launched_6mo.notes: Maximum publicly emerged from stealth and introduced its AI-native banking operating system on August 3, 2026, within May 9–November 9, 2026. This was a public product introduction, not evidence that a bank deployment was already in production.

pricing_page.notes: The navigation and footer have no pricing link; the commercial call to action is Request access.

employee_band.notes: The value is a schema-required placeholder, not an asserted band. LinkedIn lists company size as 11–50, which spans two permitted bands. Its 11 associated profiles do not establish total headcount. A separate listing reporting 39 employees belongs to the unrelated, closed employer-branding agency and was excluded.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Only three software-engineering openings are listed; no SDR, BDR, or account-executive opening appears.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed the product homepage, careers descriptions, privacy policy, newsroom and linked announcements, and searched for documentation, security/trust disclosures, subprocessors, and named providers. No public model/provider disclosure was found; references to AI coding agents do not identify the product's model provider.

named_customers.notes: No customer directory, case studies, or qualifying review listing was found. Company announcements refer to banks without naming them; August launch coverage explicitly reports no publicly named bank customers.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The listed openings are Senior Staff Software Engineer, Staff Software Engineer, and Senior Software Engineer. None has a qualifying AI, ML, or data-science title.

compliance_certs.notes: The privacy policy names none of SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS as company compliance certifications.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable job descriptions name engineering technologies but no CRM or sales/marketing systems.

product_one_liner.value: Maximum provides an AI-native banking operating system that helps banks automate operational workflows, deploy custom agents, and build financial products.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The value is a schema-required placeholder, not an asserted negative. No complete, dated executive-team history or qualifying appointment/departure announcement was found. Founder Randy Fernando is identified, but that alone does not establish a leadership change during the window.

eng_blog.notes: The public editorial index contains funding announcements and investment/media coverage, not engineer-authored technical posts. The indexed /blog/contact.html URL renders the homepage rather than an engineering blog.
